Clear the taint on resource instances — `tofu untaint`: the next up plans them as their configuration says, without replacing them. A state edit, applied at once.

| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Workspace alias, as 'open' named it. Omit for the workspace opened without an alias ('default'), however many others are open. |
